title: Admit record publication only against a fresh contained basis
statement: The Work records Module shall admit ordinary writes only against the associated project, current revision and declared basis under transaction and maintenance exclusion.

what.problem: A validated candidate can become stale before publication, and an adapter-specific write path can bypass protection of other work.
what.desired_outcome: All supported writers make the same bounded freshness and target-safety decision against the state actually used for publication.

why.rationale: SR-044 requires conflict detection and safe retry before any candidate can become authoritative; preview or earlier structural success cannot reserve a state.

conditions: A supported creation or current-record task requests publication.
A candidate is repeated after preview, contention or a lost response.

contexts: IF-003 publication admission for one selected Change under SQLite writer exclusion and whole-store maintenance coordination.
Explicitly declared contained decision-basis subjects remain outside the write set.

how.approach: Apply the current v4 SQLite task and maintenance contract. Associate the stable project identity with the selected database and enforce safe contained paths for retained payloads and reads.

how_much.scope: This allocation preserves its existing parent SR and accountable Module. Prior v3 file-journal mechanisms are historical at 39be9c81; current maintenance remains separately explicit.

acceptance_criteria: Associate the stable project identity with the selected database and enforce safe contained paths for retained payloads and reads.
BEGIN IMMEDIATE excludes competing ordinary writers; expected opaque revision is checked in the transaction.
Declared compared subjects are checked without silently replacing caller expectations; reported basis remains actor-attributed.
Maintenance exclusion prevents ordinary operations from observing a partially activated replacement.
A stale lost-response retry conflicts even if its desired state equals current content; fresh no-op does not increment semantic revision.
Unknown schema, mismatched project, corrupt store or unavailable required filesystem primitives stop without creating an empty substitute.
constraints: Current v4 SQLite realization; source observations do not establish engineering approval or passing implementation proof.

sources.basis: Derived from SR-044 for the proposed MOD-011 responsibility. Allocates SR-044 acceptance criteria 1, 3, and 4, and the admission portions of criteria 2, 5, and 6 to FUNC-046. AR-021 owns durable publication and AR-022 applies the same protection boundary to explicit recovery. These criteria specify intended observations, not executed product evidence or an adoption of the REM authoring format by the CLI.
